stemMd: Which competition brief would best accommodate both authors' concerns?

options.label: A
options.textMd: One that mandates accessible all-weather use and asks entrants to explain how the design creates an inviting public place.

options.label: B
options.textMd: One that makes maintenance optional whenever a design looks distinctive.

options.label: C
options.textMd: One that chooses the most photographed image before considering access.

options.label: D
options.textMd: One that accepts only a checklist and forbids discussion of public experience.

explanationMd: Combine the shared indispensable practical requirements with the second author's call for a broader public-life account. The resulting brief includes both conditions and interpretive design goals.

distractorRationale.c: This contradicts the first author's priority.
distractorRationale.d: This excludes the second author's additional criteria.
distractorRationale.b: The first treats maintenance as a defining condition.
